challenges.evidence: On the August 10, 2026 earnings call, management disclosed that approximately 20% of the global workforce had been reduced on July 22, 2026. This predates the recent-changes window but is a documented restructuring challenge.
Management reported “softer conditions in the down market” and a volatile top-of-funnel environment. The CFO said guidance did not assume a rebound in performance marketing or top-of-funnel activity.
challenges.challenge: Softer downmarket demand and uneven customer acquisition.

challenges.evidence: Management explicitly said, “There is a lot of cost related to AI,” and described near-term headwinds as products changed and gained agentic capabilities.
challenges.challenge: Funding and executing the AI transition while managing near-term headwinds.

what_they_do.value: monday.com is the AI workspace where people lead and agents act, turning strategy into execution at scale.

recent_changes.headline: Elevate recap details the AI workspace and enterprise roadmap
recent_changes.summary: The November 3 recap described Sidekick, ready-to-use agents and Vibe apps, organization-wide agent sharing, and AI governance controls. It also announced Datasets and Organization Hub with general release planned for the first half of 2027; these should not be treated as generally available.

recent_changes.headline: monday.com-built Harmony launches for enterprise sales conversations
recent_changes.summary: Harmony launched voice AI agents for sales conversations, qualification, objection handling, and warm transfers. At launch, it was available to mid-market and enterprise customers in the United States, United Kingdom, Australia, and Singapore.

recent_changes.headline: Elevate ’26 program emphasizes hands-on agent deployment
recent_changes.summary: Announced an AI-focused certification curriculum, partner implementation sessions, and guided agent-building experiences designed to move customers from experimentation to practical application.

priorities.evidence: The Elevate recap highlighted Sidekick, ready-to-use agents and Vibe apps, the ability to bring agents from other platforms, and an agent directory for organization-wide sharing.
priorities.priority: Make the AI workspace usable across the organization, not just by technical specialists.

priorities.evidence: The company described granular AI access permissions, human oversight, and user-level spending controls. As of November 3, 2026, Datasets and Organization Hub were on the roadmap for general release in the first half of 2027.
priorities.priority: Build enterprise-grade AI governance, administration, and scale.

priorities.evidence: Chief Revenue Officer Casey George said monday.com would accelerate its Forward Deployed Engineer model to help customers deploy purpose-built AI applications and agents, and continue investing upmarket.
priorities.priority: Expand enterprise selling and hands-on AI implementation.

priorities.priority: Extend AI into revenue-generating customer conversations.

citations.title: Updates from Elevate ‘26: The monday.com AI workspace you already count on - built for what’s next | monday.com Blog
excerpts: [monday.com](https://monday.com/blog/author/the-monday-com-team/) • Nov 3, 2026 • 5 min read

**AI that’s for everyone.** Getting started with AI shouldn’t take expertise. Sidekick, your own personal assistant, is all set to help you. Ready-to-use agents and Vibe apps, built by industry experts, are available from day one. Describe what you want, and monday will walk you through the rest. Or build your own!

**AI that empowers your whole organization.** AI creates the most value when shared across the business. Agents work where and how your whole organization works, like any other user. Bring in agents from any platform and manage them alongside your monday.com agents. Agents built by any team are available to everyone in the organization through the agent directory.

**Governed AI for your most important work.** AI does the work, you make the call. You choose what AI can access, down to a single board or Slack channel, and nothing is accessible by default. You decide where you stay in the loop and what AI can do on its own. You control the spend: set limits for every user, get alerted before a budget runs out, and see where credits go.

**Datasets:** A new entity built on mondayDB, natively integrated with the rest of your workspace. A single dataset grows 100x from its previous 100K item limit to 10M items. General release: H1 2027.

**Organization Hub:** One place to oversee every account across the AI workspace, CRM and Service, including plans, products, regions, admins and user counts, plus user management and AI spend. General release: H1 2027.

basis.reasoning: The dated recap documents the capabilities and roadmap. November 3 is used as the publication date, while future general-release timing remains explicitly prospective.

citations.title: monday.com - Voice AI Platform Harmony Launches to Convert Customer Conversations into Revenue
excerpts: October 19, 2026

TEL AVIV, Israel & NEW YORK--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- [Harmony](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fharmony.ai%2F&esheet=54624155&newsitemid=20261019455948&lan=en-US&anchor=Harmony&index=1&md5=f59e42ed6e531109c4637970cb25d03a) , a voice AI agent platform purpose-built for enterprise sales teams, launched today to help businesses unlock growth.

Built by [monday.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fmonday.com&esheet=54624155&newsitemid=20261019455948&lan=en-US&anchor=monday.com&index=2&md5=6a9539a63bb953289847a2da9f8163be) (Nasdaq: MNDY), Harmony’s specialized, small Large Language Models (LLMs) enable its agents to navigate real-world calls with speed and precision, increasing revenue by turning pipelines that businesses have already paid for into closed deals faster and more consistently than any team could on its own.

Harmony agents handle all live call scenarios and run the full sales cycle, from prospecting, discovery, and qualification to objection handling, pitching, and warm transfers to live reps with a full briefing.
Harmony is now available for mid-market and enterprise customers in the United States, United Kingdom, Australia, and Singapore, with additional markets and languages to come.

basis.reasoning: The launch release establishes the date, monday.com relationship, sales functionality, and initial market availability.
